title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-10-24
lineage: Maxell XLIIS > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. September 2012
source: Source: AUD > ? > Cassette, kindly provided by Seaweed1010.

ai_review.summary: Clear stereo audience tape captures an average Winterland set highlighted by a rare Cryptical > Cosmic Charlie transition and a standout Easy Wind jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is a surprisingly clear, boomy stereo AUD that offers good balance (Tom Constanten up in the mix) despite being only half of the short one‑set show. Musically the night is average overall, but it shines with an unusual Cryptical > Cosmic Charlie segue and a three‑way solo jam on Easy Wind featuring Pigpen, Tom Constanten and Garcia.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers note decent to good sound quality and praise unique musical moments, but the show is described as average and only partially captured, leading to a mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo AUD with clear, boomy Winterland ambience; TC (Tom Constanten) prominent in mix; no major distortion or dropout noted, but only half the set is present.

standout_songs: Easy Wind (jam with Pigpen, Tom Constanten & Garcia)
poor_songs: The Other One (mostly missing and not a raging performance)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Short one‑set opening for Jefferson Airplane; only partial tapes captured, with banter after China>Rider and an abrupt segue into Cosmic Charlie.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia joins Pigpen and Tom Constanten in a three‑way solo jam on Easy Wind and goes "utterly bananas" during the Cryptical > Cosmic intro.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) is up in the mix and solos alongside Garcia and Pigpen.
